description: Search the catalog by meaning and keywords: dataset names, titles, everyday search phrases in English and Spanish, summaries, descriptions, and column names and descriptions. Plain wording works ('kids missing school', 'jobless', 'desempleo'), as do acronyms ('ap', 'el', 'ib'). Returns short dataset summaries, best first, with the fields and columns that matched, a `confidence` of 'high', 'medium' or 'low' (low: nothing in the catalog may fit), plus `dimension_matches` when a lookup table fits (e.g. 'school directory'). main_topic, level and year narrow the results to datasets that have them. The query text is sent to Voyage AI to compute its meaning; the results come only from this catalog.

level.description: Only datasets published at this geographic level: 'states', 'counties', 'districts', 'schools', 'tracts' or 'block_groups' (singular forms work). Omit for all.
level.title: Level

limit.description: Most results to return (default 20, at most 100).
limit.title: Limit

main_topic.description: Only datasets in this subject area. Omit for all.
main_topic.title: Main Topic

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'graduation rate'.
query.title: Query

year.description: Only datasets with data for this year. Omit for all.
year.title: Year

name: search_datasets
title: Search Datasets
